sources.title: Wikipedia: Ronald Reagan
sources.description: President of the United States from 1981 to 1989

notes.text: Ronald Wilson Ronald Reagan was an American politician and actor who served as the 40th president of the United States from 1981 to 1989.
The period encompassing his presidency is known as the Ronald Reagan era.
Ronald Reagan is remembered as a politician connected with United States.
Ronald Reagan's recorded life dates place this profile around 1911-2004.
Ronald Reagan is grouped with Justice, Governance & Leadership in the People Library.
